text.autoconfig.syncac.title: Syncac Config
text.autoconfig.syncac.option.tpsFinderR:
This will be the regex used for finding the server TPS in the player list footer.
This will NOT work if the tps is in the header.
(NOTE: The MSPT field doesn't actually do anything. It's just there for in the future I might wanna add something)
text.autoconfig.syncac.option.attackInte: Sets the delay between attacks (in ticks)
text.autoconfig.syncac.option.attackSync: Synchronizes the delay between attacks with Carpet Mod Log TPS in the player list Footer, in case the server is lagging/slowed down
text.autoconfig.syncac.option.attackHold: Emulates holding down the attack button. Interval does not matter while using hold.
text.autoconfig.syncac.option.useInterva: Sets the delay between uses (in ticks)
text.autoconfig.syncac.option.useHold.@T: Emulates holding down the use button.
text.autoconfig.syncac.option.useSync.@T: Synchronizes the delay between uses with Carpet Mod Log TPS in the player list Footer, in case the server is lagging/slowed down
alert.syncac.toggle_use: Syncac use: %s, with an interval of: %s
alert.syncac.toggle_attack: Syncac attack: %s, with an interval of: %s
